meta.title: Map of agent-switch
meta.summary: 320 files · 19 areas · 3725 trusted links · guess share 0.6 %

analyses.deadBasis: exports unchecked: the extractor records no exportedness, so an exported but unimported file counts as dead; entry files and files reached by a guessed link are never counted

health.formula: Score = sum of four parts, 25 points each, each part loses its points linearly up to a limit: dead = 25 × (1 − min(1, dead code files / scope files ÷ 0.20)); cycles = 25 × (1 − min(1, file cycles ÷ (2 % of scope files))); guesses = 25 × (1 − min(1, guessed edge share ÷ 0.30)); hotspots = 25 × (1 − min(1, hotspot files / scope files ÷ 0.05)), a hotspot being a code file with at least 20 commits in the git window and at least 500 lines. Grade A ≥ 80, B ≥ 60, C ≥ 40, D ≥ 20, else F — withheld while any part is missing.
